a. Because conduction occurs via an accessory pathway, the PR interval is prolonged
b. In orthodromic tachycardia, the QRS complexes are normally narrow
c. In antidromic tachycardia, the QRS complexes are widened
d. Atrial fibrillation in WPW can be treated with digoxin
e. Atrial fibrillation in WPW can be treated with verapamil

1. a + e
2. d + e
3. b + c 
4. a + b
5. c + e
row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context:
V atrioventrikularni smeri poteka kroženje skoraj vedno po normalni, v ventrikulo-atrijski pa po akcesorni poti (ortodromna tahikardija); kompleksi QRS so ozki (razen pri anatomskem ali funkcionalnem kračnem bloku). Izjemoma poteka kroženje v obratni smeri (antidromna tahikardija); kompleksi QRS so široki.

English: In the atrioventricular direction, the reentrant circuit almost always conducts down the normal pathway and back up the accessory pathway (orthodromic tachycardia); the QRS complexes are narrow (unless there is an anatomical or functional hemiblock). Exceptionally, the circuit conducts in the reverse direction (antidromic tachycardia); the QRS complexes are wide.

20. How is induced hypothermia therapy performed in patients after cardiac arrest?
a. Apply cold packs to the patient’s head
b. Cool the patient’s core temperature to 35–36 °C for 6 hours
c. Cool the patient’s core temperature to 32–34 °C for 6 hours
d. Cool the patient’s core temperature to 32–34 °C for 24 hours
e. Cool the patient’s core temperature to 28 °C for 12 hours
row.Text Answer: Cool the patient’s core temperature to 32–34 °C for 24 hours
row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context:
Bolnika z infuzijami na štiri stopinje ohlajene fiziološke raztopine (30 ml/kg telesne mase v 30 minutah) ter oblaganjem z ledom v predelu vratu, pazduh in dimelj shladimo na ciljno temperaturo, ki je 32–34 °C. Bolnika moramo pri ohlajanju močno sedirati, po potrebi pa tudi relaksirati, da se ne bi z drgetanjem segreval. Bolnikovo temperaturo 24 ur vzdržujemo med 32 in 34 °C, nato pustimo, da se bolnik pasivno ogreje na normalno telesno temperaturo.

English Translation

The patient is cooled with infusions of normal saline chilled to 4 °C (30 mL/kg body weight over 30 minutes) and by applying ice packs to the neck, axillae, and groin until a target core temperature of 32–34 °C is reached. The patient must be deeply sedated—and if necessary paralyzed—to prevent shivering, which would generate heat. The core temperature is maintained at 32–34 °C for 24 hours, after which the patient is allowed to rewarm passively to normothermia. English: Patients with infusions at four degrees of cooled saline (30 ml/kg body weight in 30 minutes) and ice cladding in the neck, armpits and ingredients are cooled to the target temperature of 32-34 ° C.The patient should be seriously seduced when cooled and, if necessary, relaxed so as not to heat up with shivering.The patient's temperature is maintained between 32 and 34 ° C for 24 hours, then allowed to pass the patient passively to normal body temperature.

English Translation

The Patient is Cooled with Infusions of Normal Saline Chilled to 4 ° C (30 ml/kg body weight over 30 minutes) and by Applying Ice Packs to the Neck, Axille, and Grain Until A Target Core Temperature of 32-34 ° C is reached.The Patient must be deeply sedated -and if neecessary paralyzed - to Prevent Shivering, which would generates heat.The Core temperature is mainthained at 32-34 ° C for 24 Hours, after which the Patient is allowed to reWarm passively to normothermia.

row.Question:
23. In which patients do we need to be very careful when using spironolactone?
A. In hypertensive patients
B. In patients with renal failure

4. B, C, and D
5. D and E
row.Text Answer: 3. In which patients do we need to be very careful when using spironolactone?
row.Reference: Harrison’s Principles of Internal Medicine (2022)
row.Page: Chapter 253: Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction (HFrEF)
row.Context: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs), such as spironolactone, are recommended for patients with HFrEF who remain symptomatic despite optimal medical therapy. Regular monitoring of renal function and serum potassium levels is essential in these patients.

row.Question:
24. The main mechanism of treating heart failure with cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) is:
A. Electroconversion
B. Mechanical coordination of left ventricular contraction
C. Shortening of the QRS duration and consequent mechanical synchronization of the left ventricle
D. Prevention of arrhythmias by antitachycardia pacing
E. Electrical stimulation to prevent bradycardias and the resulting cardiomyopathy
row.Text Answer: Shortening of the QRS duration and consequent mechanical synchronization of the left ventricle
row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context:
Z dvoprekatnim spodbujanjem naj bi zdravili bolnike s srčnim popuščanjem v funkcijskih razredih med NYHA II in IV, z iztisnim deležem levega prekata pod 35 odstotki in širino kompleksa QRS nad 130 ms. V raziskavah so imeli boljši odziv na tovrstno zdravljenje bolniki z levokračničnim blokom kot bolniki z desnokračničnim blokom. Zdravljenje srčnega popuščanja z dvoprekatnim spodbujanjem temelji na spoznanju, da se pri skoraj 30 odstotkih bolnikov s srčnim popuščanjem pojavijo prevodne motnje v srcu, zlasti levokračni blok. Posledica prevodnih motenj je nesinhrono krčenje levega prekata, zaradi česar se dodatno zmanjša iztisni delež in poslabša polnitev levega prekata, poslabša se tudi mitralna regurgitacija. Z dvoprekatno elektrostimulacijo srca (slika 2.98) zmanjšamo nesinhronost krčenja levega prekata. English:
Biventricular pacing is used to treat patients with heart failure in functional classes NYHA II to IV, with a left ventricular ejection fraction below 35% and a QRS complex width over 130 ms. Studies have shown that patients with left bundle branch block respond better to this treatment than patients with right bundle branch block. The treatment of heart failure with biventricular pacing is based on the understanding that in almost 30% of patients with heart failure, conduction disturbances in the heart develop, especially left bundle branch block. The consequence of these conduction disturbances is asynchronous contraction of the left ventricle, which further reduces the ejection fraction and impairs left ventricular filling, also worsening mitral regurgitation. Biventricular cardiac pacing (figure 2.98) reduces the asynchrony of left ventricular contraction.

row.Question:
25. Which conduction disturbances are not seen on a 12-lead ECG?
A. First-degree AV block
B. Third-degree AV block
C. Left posterior hemiblock
D. Left bundle branch block
E. First-degree sinoatrial block
row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context: Sinoatrijski blok. Podobno kakor pri atrioventrikularnih blokih tudi pri sinoatrijskem bloku razlikujemo blok prve, druge in tretje stopnje. Patofiziološko je sinoatrijski blok motnja sinoatrijskega prevajanja ali njegovo popolno prenehanje. Prvostopenjski sinoatrijski blok označuje trajno podaljšan čas sinoatrijskega prevajanja, brez izpadov; tega bloka ne moremo diagnosticirati elektrokardiografsko. English: Sinoatrial block. Just like with atrioventricular blocks, in sinoatrial block we distinguish between first, second, and third degrees. Pathophysiologically, sinoatrial block is a disturbance or complete cessation of sinoatrial conduction. First-degree sinoatrial block is characterized by a persistently prolonged conduction time of the sinoatrial impulse, without dropped beats; this block cannot be diagnosed by electrocardiography.

B. 1-3 months of combined antiplatelet therapy with aspirin and clopidogrel is recommended
C. Patients are prescribed anticoagulant therapy with warfarin
D. A combination of antiplatelet and anticoagulant therapy is recommended
E. Restenosis in peripheral artery stents does not occur
row.Text Answer: 1-3 months of combined antiplatelet therapy with aspirin and clopidogrel is recommended
row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context: Žilne opornice (stenti) dopolnjujejo perkutano transluminalno angioplastiko zlasti v področju medeničnih in podključničnih arterij. Pri postavitvi žilnih opornic v periferne arterije priporočamo dvojno antiagregacijsko zdravljenje z acetilsalicilno kislino in klopidogrelom v trajanju od 1 do 3 mesecev. English: Vascular stents (stents) complement percutaneous transluminal angioplasty, especially in the region of the pelvic and subclavian arteries. When vascular stents are placed in peripheral arteries, dual antiplatelet therapy with acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin) and clopidogrel is recommended for a duration of 1 to 3 months.

B. Immediate surgery with arterial bypass

Za doseganje optimalnega učinka je treba vaditi pod strokovnim nadzorom 35–50 minut 3- do 5-krat na teden vsaj šest mesecev. To achieve optimal results, it should be done under professional supervision for 35–50 minutes, 3 to 5 times per week for at least six months.

row.Question:
32.Which of the following treatments would you choose for a patient with hypokalemia [K⁺ = 2.5 mmol/l] and episodes of non-sustained ventricular tachycardia?
A. Injection of calcium gluconate, infusion of insulin with glucose, oral administration of cation-exchange resin
B. Oral treatment, 40 mmol KCl, repeated as needed
C. Parenteral treatment, 10 mmol/h KCl, patient must be in the cardiology ward
D. Parenteral treatment, 20 mmol/h KCl, patient must be in the intensive care unit
E. Dialysis, patient must be in the intensive care unit
row.Text Answer: Parenteral treatment, 10 mmol/h KCl, patient must be in the cardiology ward
row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context: Hipokalemijo po možnosti vedno zdravimo vzročno. Sprejem v bolnišnico je potreben pri bolnikih s simptomatsko hipokalemijo, motnjami srčnega ritma in pri tistih, ki potrebujejo intravensko zdravljenje hipokalemije. Korekcija hipokalemije zahteva dodajanje kalijevih soli. Dajemo jih lahko oralno ali intravensko. Varneje je K⁺ dajati oralno, saj lahko hitre spremembe K⁺ v serumu, do katerih včasih pride pri intravenskem dajanju kalijevih soli, povzročijo motnje srčnega ritma ali prevajanja. English:Hypokalemia should always be treated causally whenever possible. Hospital admission is necessary for patients with symptomatic hypokalemia, arrhythmias, and for those requiring intravenous treatment of hypokalemia. Correction of hypokalemia requires supplementation with potassium salts, which can be administered orally or intravenously. It is safer to administer K⁺ orally because rapid changes in serum K⁺, which can occur with intravenous potassium supplementation, sometimes cause disturbances in heart rhythm or conduction.

row.Question:
33. A man with a known abdominal aortic aneurysm seeks medical help because for the past hour he has had severe pain in his right leg from the middle of the thigh downwards, accompanied by numbness. The leg appears obviously pale and cold. You feel a femoral pulse on the leg, but pulses lower down are absent. What is the diagnosis?
a. advanced peripheral arterial disease that does not require immediate intervention
b. rupture of the abdominal aortic aneurysm
c. thromboembolism in the right common iliac artery
d. thromboembolism in the right superficial femoral artery
e. iliofemoral deep vein thrombosis
row.Text Answer: thromboembolism in the right superficial femoral artery
row.Reference: Harrison’s Principles of Internal Medicine (2022)
row.Page: Chapter 302: Vascular Diseases of the Extremities
row.Context: Acute limb ischemia refers to a sudden decrease in limb perfusion that threatens the viability of the limb. It is usually caused by an embolus from the heart or proximal arteries, or by thrombosis of an atherosclerotic plaque. Symptoms include the ‘six P’s’: pain, pallor, pulselessness, paresthesia, paralysis, and poikilothermia. The presence of a known aneurysm (such as an abdominal aortic aneurysm) increases the risk of embolic events. Prompt diagnosis and revascularization are essential for limb salvage and to prevent major morbidity.

row.Question:
34. On an arteriographic image, which of the following is characteristic of Buerger's disease?
A. Large arteries of the pelvis and thigh are often affected
B. Along the arterial occlusion, we see spiral (corkscrew) collaterals that develop from the vasa vasorum and run in the vessel wall
C. Abundant atherosclerotic plaques in the arteries of the lower limbs
D. Digital arteries in the hands and feet are never affected
E. The angiographic image is the only criterion for diagnosing Buerger's disease
row.Text Answer: Along the arterial occlusion, we see spiral (corkscrew) collaterals that develop from the vasa vasorum and run in the vessel wall
row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context: Angiografsko dokažemo prizadetost malih in srednje velikih arterij na udih, kot so digitalne arterije prstov rok in nog, arterije palmarnega in plantarnega loka, radialna, ulnarna arterija in golenske arterije. Značilne so spiralaste, »vitičaste« kolaterale, ki se oblikujejo iz vasa vasorum in potekajo vzdolž žilne stene. Poplitealna arterija ostaja praviloma prehodna, prav tako brahialna arterija. English: Angiographically, involvement of small and medium-sized arteries in the limbs is demonstrated, such as the digital arteries of the fingers and toes, the arteries of the palmar and plantar arches, the radial and ulnar arteries, and the tibial arteries. Characteristic are spiral, “corkscrew” collaterals that develop from the vasa vasorum and run along the vessel wall.

row.Question:
35. What is the mortality of acute type A aortic dissection?
A. All patients die immediately
B. 10% per minute for the first 5 minutes, then 5% per hour
C. 10% per hour for the first 5 hours, then 5% per hour
D. 1-2% per hour for the first 48 hours
E. Patients rarely die from late complications
row.Text Answer: 1-2% per hour for the first 48 hours
row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context: Prognoza. Smrtnost disekcije aorte je velika, pri tipu A znaša brez zdravljenja 1 do 2 odstotka na uro prvih 48 ur. Pri operiranih bolnikih je pogosta ponovitev bolezni na drugem mestu aorte, ki lahko narekuje nov kirurški poseg, zato so indicirane kontrole, v prvem letu trikrat, nato vsako leto. English: Prognosis. The mortality of aortic dissection is high; in type A, it is 1 to 2 percent per hour during the first 48 hours if untreated. In operated patients, recurrence of the disease at another site of the aorta is common and may require a new surgical intervention; therefore, follow-up is indicated, three times in the first year, then annually.

row.Question:
36. The so-called Beck’s triad, characteristic of cardiac tamponade, means:
A. Arterial hypertension, bradycardia, mydriasis
B. Hypotension, decreased central venous pressure, loud first heart sound
C. Hypotension, increased central venous pressure, muffled heart sounds
D. Pulsus paradoxus, distended neck veins, third heart sound
E. Tachycardia, sweating, full neck veins
row.Text Answer: Hypotension, increased central venous pressure, muffled heart sounds
row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context: V klinični sliki tamponade izstopajo hipotenzija, zvišanje centralnega venskega tlaka in tiho srce (t. i. Beckova triada). Zaradi zmanjšanega minutnega volumna srca so prisotni še dispneja, ortopneja in refleksna tahikardija. row.Question:
3. Radical resection of the colon (R0 resection) in colorectal cancer means:
A. removal of the colon segment with adequate safety margins in healthy tissue (no microscopic residual tumor, no macroscopic residual tumor) and removal of involved lymph nodes
B. limited resection of part of the colon without removal of regional lymph nodes
C. endoscopic resection of the tumor with a laser
D. endoscopic resection of the tumor with coagulation
E. enteroenteroanastomosis
row.Text Answer: removal of the colon segment with adequate safety margins in healthy tissue (no microscopic residual tumor, no macroscopic residual tumor) and removal of involved lymph nodes
row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context: Standardna radikalna resekcija (hemikolektomija) je monoblok resekcija ustreznega dela črevesa z zadostnim varnostnim robom z vsem pripadajočim mezenterijem in bezgavkami ter prekinitvijo pripadajočih žil na odcepiščih. Razširjena radikalna resekcija zajema praviloma še obe sosednji drenažni področji. Pri raku zgornje tretjine danke izvedemo sprednjo anteriorno resekcijo, pri raku srednje tretjine nizko sprednjo resekcijo z mezorektalno ekscizijo, izjemoma ekscizijo danke. English: Standard radical resection (hemicolectomy) is a monobloc resection of the appropriate part of the intestine with an adequate safety margin, including all associated mesentery and lymph nodes, as well as ligation of the corresponding vessels at their origins. Extended radical resection generally also includes the two adjacent drainage areas. In cancer of the upper third of the rectum, an anterior resection is performed; in cancer of the middle third, a low anterior resection with mesorectal excision is done, and in exceptional cases, excision of the rectum itself.

C. severing both trunks of the vagus nerve at the level of the cardia

B. With a proton-pump inhibitor
C. Surgical esophagectomy

row.Text Answer: All of the above are correct
row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context: Zdravljenje. Najučinkovitejše zdravljenje je preprečiti stik z alergenom v hrani, ki povzroča eozinofilni ezofagitis. Raziskave so odkrile šest skupin živil, ki jih postopoma ali po posebnih algoritmih izločamo iz bolnikove diete: mleko in mlečni izdelki, jajca, žita (predvsem z gluteno), soja, oreški in morska hrana. Najpogostejši sprožilci so v mleku in žitih, zato jih izločimo najprej. Izločevalna dieta je za bolnike pogosto težavna in se je ne držijo dosledno, zato po smernicah najprej uvedemo zdravljenje z zaviralci protonske črpalke. Okoli 40 odstotkov bolnikov se dobro odziva na tovrstno zdravljenje. V tem primeru govorimo o na zaviralce protonske črpalke odzivni ezofagalni eozinofiliji. Ta izraz se postopoma opušča, saj je vedno več dokazov, da gre le za obliko eozinofilnega ezofagitisa. Če zdravljenje z zaviralci protonske črpalke in dietni ukrepi niso učinkoviti, uvedemo zdravljenje z lokalnimi glukokortikoidi (flutikazon, budezonid, ciklezonid). Tako pride zdravilo v stik s sluznico požiralnika, pri čemer deluje lokalno in ima le minimalne sistemske učinke. Učinkovitost zdravljenja z lokalnimi glukokortikoidi ocenjujemo na podlagi biopsij, ki po uspešni terapiji prikazujejo zmanjšanje števila eozinofilcev. English: Treatment. The most effective treatment is to avoid the food allergen causing eosinophilic esophagitis. Studies have identified six food groups to be eliminated gradually or according to specific algorithms from the patient’s diet: milk and dairy products, eggs, grains (especially gluten-containing), soy, nuts, and seafood. The most common triggers are milk and grains, so these are eliminated first. An elimination diet is often difficult for patients to follow consistently, so guidelines recommend initiating proton-pump inhibitor therapy first. Approximately 40 percent of patients respond well to this treatment. In such cases, the condition is termed proton-pump inhibitor–responsive esophageal eosinophilia, a term that is being phased out as evidence increasingly supports that this is merely a variant of eosinophilic esophagitis. If proton-pump inhibitors and dietary measures are ineffective, treatment with topical glucocorticoids is introduced (fluticasone, budesonide, ciclesonide). This allows the medication to contact the esophageal mucosa directly, exerting a local effect with minimal systemic absorption. Treatment efficacy is assessed by biopsy, which, after successful therapy, shows a reduction in eosinophil count.

row.Context: Poleg standardnih krvnih parametrov, kot so krvna slika, C-reaktivni protein (CRP) in sedimentacija, uporabljamo še novejši parameter, fekalni kalprotektin. Kalprotektin se nahaja v nevtrofilnih granulocitih in se iz vnete črevesne sluznice sprošča v lumen prebavne cevi. It is a sensitive biological marker of intestinal mucosal inflammation and is already an established screening test to differentiate between organic and functional causes of intestinal symptoms. The concentration of calprotectin in the stool correlates well with endoscopic disease activity in Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.

19. Najpomembnejša značilnost ascitesa pri spontanem bakterijskem peritonitisu je (obkroži pravilni odgovor):

b. Koncentracija LDH je višja od serumske.
c. Povišano število nevtrofilnih granulocitov.

row.Reference: Interna medicina (6. izd., str. XXXVIII, 1693). (2022). Medicinska fakulteta; Buča.
row.Context:
Diagnozo potrdimo z laboratorijsko preiskavo punktata ascitesa. Pri spontanem bakterijskem peritonitisu je ascites navadno moten, ima značilnosti transudata, koncentracija beljakovin v ascitesu pa je ponavadi nizka, pod 10 g/L. Ključno za postavitev diagnoze je število nevtrofilcev v mm³ ascitesa. Če je število nevtrofilnih levkocitov večje ali enako 250, gre za spontani bakterijski peritonitis, ne glede na to, ali so klinični simptomi in znaki okužbe navzoči ali ne, in ne glede na to, ali je kultura ascitesa pozitivna ali negativna. English:
The diagnosis is confirmed by laboratory examination of the ascitic fluid. In spontaneous bacterial peritonitis, the ascitic fluid is usually turbid, has the characteristics of a transudate, and the protein concentration in the ascitic fluid is usually low, below 10 g/L. The key to establishing the diagnosis is the number of neutrophils per mm³ in the ascitic fluid. If the number of neutrophilic leukocytes is greater than or equal to 250, it is considered spontaneous bacterial peritonitis, regardless of whether clinical symptoms and signs of infection are present or not, and regardless of whether the culture of the ascitic fluid is positive or negative.

The overall incidence of lymphoid neoplasms is 12.1/100,000, placing this group in seventh place among all cancers. Incidence varies significantly across different regions of the world—higher incidence rates are characteristic of industrialized, developed countries, while the actual burden of disease in developing countries cannot be precisely assessed. The lowest incidence rates have been found in East Asia.

The frequency of non-Hodgkin lymphomas has been increasing year by year, but in some countries (e.g., the USA), the rise in incidence has already plateaued. In the period from 1975 to 1991 in the USA, the incidence increased by 3.6% annually, while from 1991 to 2003, it increased by 0.4% annually. In Slovenia, the incidence of non-Hodgkin lymphomas in the period 2006 to 2010 was 9.8% higher than in the period 2001 to 2005; an 8.7% increase in incidence was expected in 2013 compared to the period 2006 to 2010.

The incidence of Hodgkin lymphoma has remained roughly the same for a long time. Hodgkin lymphoma most commonly affects young adults aged 15 to 34 and older adults over the age of 50. The incidence of non-Hodgkin lymphomas increases exponentially with age between 20 and 79 years.

In Slovenia, more than 650 patients with newly diagnosed lymphoid neoplasms are treated annually. According to the Cancer Registry of the Republic of Slovenia, in 2012, 614 patients were diagnosed with B and T cell lymphomas (excluding acute lymphoblastic leukemias, which affected 22 patients in the same year), and 34 patients were diagnosed with Hodgkin lymphoma.

row.Reference: Strojan, P., & Hočevar, M. (Eds.). (2018). Onkologija: Učbenik za študente medicine [Oncology: Textbook for medical students] (1st ed.). Onkološki inštitut Ljubljana.
row.Context:
Patients treated for lymphomas have an increased risk of developing acute leukemia (most often acute myeloid leukemia) or myelodysplastic syndrome, which is a consequence of previous treatment with alkylating agents, etoposide, or doxorubicin.
The most common cause of cardiac complications in cancer patients are anthracyclines. They play a key role in the treatment of many types of cancer, both in adults and in children, and are among the most effective anticancer drugs, having been in use for over forty years. The main representative of this group is doxorubicin. They can cause both acute and chronic cardiotoxicity. Acute toxicity, which presents as transient heart failure or arrhythmia, is usually reversible, whereas chronic toxicity is typically irreversible. The latter results from the loss of myofibrils and damage to the cardiomyocytes in the heart muscle. Over one or more years—or even decades—after treatment, this can lead to asymptomatic systolic and/or diastolic dysfunction of the left ventricle, and subsequently to congestive cardiomyopathy and congestive heart failure.

row.Context:
Radical cystectomy with removal of regional lymph nodes is the standard treatment for muscle-invasive bladder cancer. Analyses of treatment outcomes for T2 tumors have shown that patients who undergo cystectomy within ninety days of the cancer diagnosis have significantly better survival than those in whom radical treatment is delayed.
In this surgery, in women, in addition to the bladder and regional lymph nodes, the uterus, anterior vaginal wall, ovaries, and urethra are also removed. In men, the bladder is removed along with the prostate and seminal vesicles, and regional lymph nodes are removed.
Radical cystectomy can be performed as an open surgery, laparoscopically, or laparoscopically with robotic assistance.

row.Context: Brachytherapy is characterized by complex logistics and requires access to the tumor. Depending on the dose of radiation received, at the lowest doses the most sensitive organs (e.g., bone marrow) are damaged; at higher doses, the small intestine is affected; and at still higher doses, other organ systems with an even higher threshold for deterministic radiation effects are damaged. At extremely high doses (gamma rays, 100 Gy), death ensues within 24 to 48 hours due to the so-called cerebrovascular syndrome (blood–brain barrier failure). row.Context: Hyponatremia is a relatively common electrolyte disturbance in patients with cancer, and one of the most frequent causes is the syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion (SIADH). This is a paraneoplastic syndrome resulting from ectopic secretion of antidiuretic hormone (ADH) or an ADH‐like protein. In the kidneys, this leads to excessive water reabsorption, plasma osmolality decreases, and the patient excretes inappropriately concentrated urine. In reality, there is no true sodium deficiency: hyponatremia is secondary to hypoosmolality of the plasma due to water excess. SIADH occurs most often in small‐cell lung cancer (75 % of all SIADH cases in malignancy), but it is also common in pancreatic cancer, mesothelioma, primary brain tumors, and brain metastases.

row.Reference: Peritonsillar Abscess - StatPearls - NCBI
row.Context: The classic symptoms and signs of peritonsillar abscess are sore throat, odynophagia [painful swallowing], trismus (spasm of the jaw muscles causing the mouth to remain tightly closed), and a 'hot potato' voice.
